title: parse_message_id_and_newsgroups does not handle folded headers — misses multi-line Newsgroups
description: pipeline.rs parse_message_id_and_newsgroups scans headers line-by-line but does not handle RFC 5322 header folding (continuation lines starting with SP or HTAB). A Newsgroups header folded across two lines will have its second line silently ignored, causing the pipeline to store the article under only the first group. compare: ingestion.rs extract_body_msgid correctly handles folding. parse_message_id_and_newsgroups needs the same folding logic.
